title: File:Mairis Briedis 2018.jpg
desc: Mairis Briedis is a Latvian professional boxer. He is the first Latvian to win a boxing world title, having held the WBC cruiserweight title from April 2017 to January 2018. Picture is from his last public training for media in Latvia, 11 days before the fight against Noel Gevor
